description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to remove new glazed link, retain existing fire escape staircase and construct new partially glazed stair lobby and entrance for new flats of planning permission 01151/H/P10 approved 16/03/2018 for the erection of a three-storey building, to create three additional flats.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three year from the issue of permission reference 01151/H/P10 dated 16/03/2018.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A010612/DP1-A; A010612/DP2-A; A010612/DP14-A; A010612/S01; Location Plan; Received 03/02/2016; A010612/DP13-B; A010612/DP15-B; Received 24/01/2018; Daylight/Sunlight Assessment; Received 19/01/2018.Transport Statement; Received 22/01/2018; A010612/WD08-E; A010612/WD09; Received 26/02/2018. A010612/DP8 Rev H; A010612/DP9 Rev G and A010612/DP11 Rev M. Received: 07/12/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The external surfaces of the hereby approved development shall only be constructed from the materials approved under application 01151/H/P10(3i) approved 31/07/2018 and application 01151/H/P10(3,7,10,11) approved 01/10/2018 unless otherwise first agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 9:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - During construction works an appropriate wheel-washing system shall be provided to remove mud, stones and any other extraneous materials from the wheels and chassis' of construction vehicles exiting the site and all loads of construction materials, excavation spoil or other such matter shall be fully covered in order to ensure that no material leaves the site attached to the vehicle which might subsequently be deposited on the highway. The exit from the wheel washing system shall be constructed from a hard, non-porous surfacing material and sited as far away from the exit to the highway as is possible given the constraints of the site and the surface shall be kept clean at all times. Waste water discharged from the wheel washing system shall be stored and disposed of on site and shall not be discharged into the public sewerage system without prior removal of soil, stones and any other suspended material. Suitable measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties shall also be provided in accordance with the guidance at http://www.london.gov.uk/mayor/environment/air_quality/docs/construction-dust-bpg.pdf and site lighting shall be designed, positioned and directed so as not to unnecessarily intrude on passing drivers on public highways and so as not to direct light into any windows of properties outside the site. Start of works on site shall be notified to the Council's Community Environment Team on 020 8583 5070.
Condition : 6 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 7 - Hard and soft landscaping of the hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the details approved under application 01151/H/P10(3,7,10,11) approved 01/10/2018.

Condition : 8 - The cycle parking accommodation shown on the approved plans shall be provided before the approved dwellings are occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles or storing cycles.

Condition : 9 - The flats hereby permitted shall be designed and constructed in accordance with the Lifetime Home standards as set out in the London Plan and the ground floor flat hereby approved shall be a "Wheelchair User Dwelling" built to Building Regulations M4(3) standard.

Condition : 10 - The development shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) of sustainably sourced materials have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details of application 01151/H/P10(3,7,10,11) dated 01/10/2018.

Condition : 11 - The entrance doors to units 16 and 18 shall have either solid doors or doors with fixed and obscured windows. The doors installed in accordance with this condition shall be retained at the site thereafter.

Condition : 12 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.
